_doc: Bosch Rexroth strut profile 30x30: 30 x 30 mm with the 8 mm slot, anodised. Dimensions and section figures are from the MGE 14.0 catalogue, which prints them to 0.1 cm² and 0.1 cm⁴: on a section this small that is a step of several percent. The drawn outline leaves out the four notches round the bore, the V marks on the core and the hollows' rounded corners.
